source.dataset: HCES 2023-24 (Household Consumption Expenditure Survey), Section 12 consumption files

chart.title: Do beneficiaries of health insurance spend more on intoxicants?

x.label: Beneficiaries - non-beneficiaries monthly spending gap (Rs. per adult)

y.encoding: category (intoxicant item), ordered ascending by the maximum value across sectors (bottom = highest max)

encoding.points_per_row: one point per sector, connected by a grey line (the dumbbell)

metric.name: Beneficiary - non-beneficiary monthly spending gap
metric.definition: Per-adult monthly expenditure of health-insurance beneficiary households minus that of comparable non-beneficiary households, by sector. Adults = family_size - n_children. Weekly values converted to monthly via *52/12. Positive = beneficiaries spend more.
metric.treatment: Household is a beneficiary if is_benefit_healthscheme == 1 OR is_hhmem_pmjay == 1.
metric.matching: Propensity-score matching on num_cols=[family_size, n_children, n_elderly] and cat_cols=[sector, nss_region, employed_annual, max_income_from, hoh_religion, caste]; restricted to pscore bins D and E (closest-matched, highest-propensity strata).
